name: 15132 · Mckeesport, PA
findings: ZIP 15132 (Mckeesport) has 96 nonprofit organizations. 38 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 32 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 15132 (Mckeesport) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 15132 (Mckeesport) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 32 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.text: 12 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
